title: 46 Pine Needle Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 46 Pine Needle Way is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 9) - 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- 6 Seater Golf Cart - Natural Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Spacious Screened Porch with Fireplace and Television- Parking For 2 Vehicles- 2 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 7 Minute Golf Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club- 5 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Nestled just outside of Camp WaterColor in the Forest District, 46 Pine Needle Way is the perfect retreat for up to 9 guests. This spacious and inviting home features 4 charming bedrooms and 4.5 well-appointed bathrooms, all bathed in natural light, creating a serene atmosphere that beckons you to unwind. The primary suite is a sanctuary with a king bed, a luxurious soaking tub, and a walk-in shower—ideal for relaxing after a day of adventure. Nearby, another comfortable king bedroom awaits on the same level. Venture upstairs to discover two more beautifully designed bedrooms: one with a queen bed and twin trundle, and the other with a cozy queen bed, each with its own private bathroom for added privacy. One of the home’s highlights is the expansive screened porch, complete with a large TV and ample seating, perfect for socializing or catching up on shows while overlooking the tranquil nature preserve. A small green space in front invites kids to play, all while you savor the peaceful beauty of WaterColor from the front porch. With Camp WaterColor’s amenities just a short stroll away and the pristine WaterColor Beach Club a quick electric cart or bike ride from your door, 46 Pine Needle offers the ultimate setting for your unforgettable getaway. Embrace the charm and comfort of this delightful home! FIRST FLOOR:- Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Half Bathroom- Kitchen- Laundry- Living Room SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with Twin Trundle (3), Private Bathroom with Shower- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower
